recent_en: HSSEB recently announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, while several substantial shareholders and directors (including Tan Sri Ir. Kunasingam and Datuk Ir Teo Chok Boo) filed consecutive changes in interest in October. There were also internal dealings where the Chief Operating Officer acquired shares in the open market.
notable_en: Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Several substantial shareholders and directors filed consecutive changes in interest during October.
Chief Operating Officer Anandanayagam A/L Sharvanandan acquired shares in the open market on 17 September and 8-9 October.
risks_en: Multiple changes in substantial shareholder and director interests were filed in October; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
